definition: Largest 500 functioning whole municipal governments represented in the atlas: active general-purpose places, towns/townships and full consolidated cities (functional status A/B/C). Whole-government summary levels 162/061/170 only; never county/place parts, CDPs, statistical balances, metropolitan populations or subordinate special-purpose townships. Distinct overlapping governments remain distinct; populations must not be summed as disjoint areas.

source.provider: US Census Bureau · Vintage 2025 subcounty estimates, released May 2026
